CompanionStore.reason: Reviewed concrete production owners: LiveService/PreviewService, LocalDrafts/LocalFinished, value state and Sendable task/clock handles. Those implementations are UI-free; new Store constructor sites require review.

AnnexManualClock.reason: Lock-protected value state and Sendable task continuations; no UIKit ownership.

CompanionRuntime.reason: Owns feedback presenter with UIKit windows/controllers; retain main-actor field destruction.

CompanionMarkdown.Box.reason: Immutable markdown document value; NSObject cache wrapper has no UI fields.

CompanionLifecycle.reason: Owns injected main-actor transition closure; arbitrary captures not proved UI-free.

CompanionTelemetry.reason: Owns SDK/MetricKit/subscription objects; their destruction affinity is not proved here.

CompanionImageBytes.reason: Immutable Data bytes, Sendable; no decoded UIImage is stored.

ResourceBundleClass.reason: Xcode-generated bundle-accessor class; no source patch. Runtime path remains unprotected.

CompanionCodeScanner.Coordinator.reason: DataScanner delegate owns an injected callback; possible UI captures.

CompanionLiveService.reason: Transport/value/task state; all three production callbacks in AppRoot capture Runtime WEAKLY, not raw UI. New assignments require capture review.

CompanionLocalDrafts.reason: UserDefaults (thread-safe Foundation) plus fixed String; deinit performs no write.

CompanionPreferences.reason: Stored choices are values and UserDefaults; UIDevice is read during init, not retained.

CompanionArchiveReader.reason: Sendable transport reference and value target/session/event dictionary; no UI fields.

CompanionDecisionQueue.reason: Values/tasks plus commit closure. Reviewed production construction captures only CompanionStore, whose reviewed concrete service/persistence graph is UI-free; no raw UI capture permitted.

CompanionLocalFinished.reason: UserDefaults plus fixed String; no UI fields or deinit I/O.

CompanionMessageSlices.Box.reason: Immutable array of message-slice values; NSObject cache wrapper has no UI fields.

CompanionPartExpansion.reason: Optional Bool and Observation registrar only.

CompanionStateLifetime.reason: Restricted reviewed production constructors: Queue or Int; factory captures only actor-owned model references, never raw UI. Any new constructor site requires review. Runtime use from #213 requires re-review when merged.

CompanionTerminalFocus.reason: Only a WEAK UIKit reference and Bool/Observation registrar. Weak-slot destruction does not release the view.

CompanionPreviewService.reason: Boolean flags and Sendable AsyncStream continuation; no UI object/callback fields.

CompanionTerminalUIView.reason: UIView subclass strongly owns key-input view, layers and UI state; preserve isolation.

EnrollmentShakeReceiver.Receiver.reason: UIViewController subclass and main-only presentation/callback context.

CompanionTerminalSession.reason: Injected terminal-channel protocol can own main-only objects; preserve isolation.

CompanionTerminalKeyInput.reason: UIView/UIKeyInput subclass, session and UIKit superclass state; preserve isolation.

CompanionArchiveTranscript.reason: Injected reader protocol is not constrained to UI-free implementations.

CompanionComposerPasteHook.HookView.reason: UIView superclass owns main-only UIKit state, even though explicit references are weak.

CompanionComposerPasteHook.Coordinator.reason: Owns UITextPasteItem array and injected main-actor callback; preserve isolation.

CompanionStreamDiagnostics.reason: Value cursor map, lock-protected Sendable transport diagnostic scopes and telemetry; no UI fields.

CompanionLiveTerminalChannel.reason: Sendable transport/tasks/continuation and text/number state; no UIView, layer or delegate owned.

CompanionTranscriptExpansion.reason: Dictionary owns only ARC-safe CompanionPartExpansion values.

CompanionPreviewTerminalChannel.reason: Value scope/text/size and Sendable stream continuation; no UI fields.
